game.name: Fracture (USA, Europe)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Ko)
game.desc: Fracture is a third-person action game for Xbox 360. The action takes place in 2161, in the heart of a war between cybernetic soldiers and genetically modified fighters. The player can alter the terrain in the various levels with destructible environments thanks to the futuristic weaponry at his disposal. This allows the player to open new passages and access elevated areas. Fracture also features a multiplayer mode capable of hosting 12 fighters at the same time.
